name: SurrealEstate
description: Aided by his own remarkable abilities and an eclectic team of associates, real estate agent Luke Roman specializes in “metaphysically engaged properties,” aka haunted houses. Together they investigate, clear and close the houses nobody else can.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: The Roman Agency welcomes a new agent, as well as a new client with a connection to Luke's past.

videos.title: The Harvey
videos.overview: A little boy's "imaginary friend" interferes with his parents' plans to sell their house and move.

videos.title: For Sale by Owner
videos.overview: A lovely lake cabin may be haunted or the owner may be faking; a horror novelist seeks inspiration.

videos.title: A House Is Not a Home
videos.overview: The Roman Agency takes on a haunted master-planned subdivision and a troubled house by the sea.

videos.title: Ft. Ghost Child
videos.overview: When a rap star rents a client's recording studio, a tragic secret is revealed in the playback.

videos.title: Roman's Six
videos.overview: The Roman Agency steps in when the visitors to a competitor's Open House are murdered one by one.

videos.title: Quarantine
videos.overview: The team locks down in the office to isolate and destroy a murderous demon that followed them home.

videos.title: Baba O'Reilly
videos.overview: As Luke considers quitting paranormal clients, he encounters a house that changes his perspective.

videos.title: White Wedding
videos.overview: The team is hired by the mother-of the bride to sell a cursed family lodge.

videos.title: The House Always Wins
videos.overview: The Donovan house takes center stage as it has sent Nick to the hospital and trapped August somewhere inside.

videos.title: Trust the Process
videos.overview: Luke struggles to handle an engaged property; Susan falls in love with a home with a special power.

videos.title: Truth in Advertising
videos.overview: Luke deals with a film crew at a client's property, while Susan investigates a strange seaside B&B.

videos.title: The Butler Didn't
videos.overview: When a client is held hostage by a ghost, The Roman Agency must hurry to save him.

videos.title: I Put a Spell on You
videos.overview: Luke spars with a homeowner during negotiations as Zooey takes on her first sales call.

videos.title: Art & Science
videos.overview: Luke must improvise when a client's home traps her inside; August pays a visit to his past.

videos.title: Set Your Flag on Fire
videos.overview: A neighborly conflict draws the agency into a feud; Phil's sister arrives to settle the family will.

videos.title: Gods & Monsters
videos.overview: Luke helps a client confront the monster under his childhood bed; a new agent joins the Agency.

videos.title: Let Sleeping Dogs Lie
videos.overview: Luke reconnects with his estranged mother. Zooey investigates Susan's disappearance.

videos.title: Dearly Departed
videos.overview: The Agency must guide a ghost into the light. Meanwhile, Susan is found.

videos.title: Letting Go
videos.overview: A changed Susan returns to the Agency. Luke must use his regained powers to save the team.

videos.title: Buckaroo
videos.overview: A face from Luke's childhood returns, and the staff of Roman, Ireland investigates a ghostly cowboy.

videos.title: Night Terrors
videos.overview: The Roman, Ireland team helps a single dad with his teenage son's extranormal sleeping disorder.

videos.title: Death Does a Refi
videos.overview: Luke meets the personification of Death, who needs a little help with a former client.

videos.title: A Family Thing
videos.overview: A feuding family with a dark secret presents the biggest challenge of Zooey's young legal career.

videos.title: The Gardener
videos.overview: The team helps a client whose relationship has been disrupted by a seductive, mysterious gardener.

videos.title: Battleground
videos.overview: Susan investigates a client's home haunted by a young Vietnam-era soldier whose war never ended.

videos.title: A Slice of After-Life
videos.overview: A young couple asks Roman/Ireland to help defeat a demonic presence that has been following them.

videos.title: Perchance to Dream
videos.overview: The team experiences frightening dreams featuring a mysterious woman who died in her sleep.

videos.title: Grave Matters
videos.overview: The search for a client's last will leads the team on a deadly scavenger hunt through a graveyard.

videos.title: The Elephant in the Room
videos.overview: The Roman/Ireland team prepares for a final confrontation with Luke's childhood nemesis.
